description: This file contains a collection of stored procedures, functions, packages, and synonyms related to XML database schema support in an Oracle environment. It defines packages for namespace management, XML DOM helper functions, utility functions for file handling, resource management, and additional toolkit procedures.

methods.name: boolean_to_varchar
methods.description: Converts a BOOLEAN to its string representation ('TRUE' or 'FALSE').

methods.name: raw_to_varchar
methods.description: Converts a RAW value to its string representation ('TRUE' or 'FALSE').

methods.name: varchar_to_boolean
methods.description: Converts a VARCHAR2 string to a BOOLEAN value.

methods.name: raw_to_boolean
methods.description: Converts a RAW value to a BOOLEAN.

methods.name: boolean_to_raw
methods.description: Converts a BOOLEAN to RAW ('01' for TRUE, '00' for FALSE).

methods.name: getTextNodeValue
methods.description: Retrieves the text content of a specified child node from an XML element.

methods.name: getBooleanValue
methods.description: Retrieves and converts the text of a child node to RAW representing boolean value.

methods.name: appendElement
methods.description: Appends a child XML element to a parent XML element.

methods.name: createHomeFolder
methods.description: Creates a home folder resource for a specified user with proper ACLs.

methods.name: createDirectoryTree
methods.description: Recursively creates directory structure in the Oracle XML DB repository.

methods.name: uploadFiles
methods.description: Uploads files listed in an XML into the Oracle XML DB repository, optionally replacing existing resources.

methods.name: put_xml
methods.description: Outputs the XML content line-by-line to DBMS_OUTPUT for debugging.

methods.name: addUserMetaDataNode
methods.description: Adds or updates user metadata node for a resource in the XML DB.

methods.name: renameCollectionTable
methods.description: Renames a nested table and its associated indexes in the database schema.

methods.name: touchResource
methods.description: Updates the modification timestamp for a specified resource.

methods.name: releaseDAVLocks
methods.description: Releases locks on resources in the XML DB.
